content.text: Astrology Wiki Main Page All Pages Community Interactive Maps Recent Blog Posts Babylonian astrology Horoscopic astrology Eastern Astrology Astrology, Many Definitions Astrology Matrix of Destiny: the astrology connection Capricorn Astrology Western Astrology Sign Info Aries Taurus Gemini Aquarius Cancer Leo Western Astrology Western Astrology Sign Info Aries Taurus Gemini Aquarius Cancer Leo Help Skip to content Main Page All Pages Community Interactive Maps Recent Blog Posts Babylonian astrology Horoscopic astrology Eastern Astrology Astrology, Many Definitions Astrology Matrix of Destiny: the astrology connection Capricorn Astrology Western Astrology Sign Info Aries Taurus Gemini Aquarius Cancer Leo Western Astrology Western Astrology Sign Info Aries Taurus Gemini Aquarius Cancer Leo Help Aries Aries is the first sign of the zodiac and named after the constellation of the same name, which represents the ram with the golden fleece from Greek Mythology. It is ruled by the planet Mars, with its natural House being the first one. It's also the first of the fire signs and has a cardinal modality. Contents 1 Personality 1.1 Strengths 1.2 Weaknesses 2 Relationships 3 Properties 3.1 Element 3.2 Modality 3.3 Ruling Planet 4 The Ruling Planet For Your Z… 4.1 House 5 Mythology Personality[] Strengths[] Arians possess high willpower and a tendency to drive themselves. They have little fear of conflict, can be competitive and honest. They're incredibly bold as well as headstrong, going into challenges they face on impulse. Being motivated and having lots of passion to spare is one of their many traits. Active, either physically or mentally, Aries loves to take charge. They like to get things done as fast as possible. Their thoughts and beliefs can be quite strong, in tandem with their urge to defend them. Weaknesses[] Their desire to prove themselves can also lead to plenty of stress and heartache. This leads to a lack of patience, acting before thinking and may even have a temper. Their strong emotional reactions can blur out their sense of reason, which can become even worse when said emotions are suppressed rather than expressed. When it comes to self-control, they can be rather lacking. Relationships[] Properties[] Element[] Aries is a fire sign, along with Leo and Sagittarius. The defining trait of fire signs is intense passion. Modality[] Aries is a cardinal sign, with the other three being Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn. Ruling Planet[] The ruling planet for Aries is Mars. Mars is most often associated with action, desire and energy. It represents the primal instincts of man and rules over our ‘animal’ instincts: anger, aggression and survival. As they are primarily influenced by Mars, Aries is a passionate, high-energy sign. They are honest, direct and unafraid of anything that stands in their way.
